name: Seratu Aatai
legalName: Pertubuhan Pemuliharaan Biodiversiti Seratu Aatai Sabah
summary: Help people in Sabah live alongside Bornean elephants by reducing human-elephant conflict through research, community work and education.
programmes: Bornean elephant population estimation (Tabin and Segaliud-Deramakot-Tangkulap-Tawai)
Livelihood Insurance for Elephant (LIFE) to offset crop losses
Landscape conservation in Lower Kinabatangan with plantations and smallholders
Education and awareness, incl. Honorary Wildlife Wardens in plantation schools
beneficiaries: Bornean elephants; rural communities and smallholders in elephant ranges in Sabah

organisation.founders: Dr Nurzhafarina (Farina) Othman, elephant researcher and UMS senior lecturer; 2025 Whitley Award winner
organisation.leadership: Dr Farina Othman, Founder and Director (per Whitley Award, 2025)
